name: draft-restored-notice
title: Draft restored notice
description: Tells people their unsaved work came back after a crash or a closed tab: when it was saved, Keep or Start over, plus a useLocalDraft hook.
docs: DraftRestoredNotice takes savedAt, summary ("3 fields changed", "412 words"), timeZone and locale, onKeep, onDiscard (called after a second press of Start over) and onClosed (after it has folded away). It is a polite status, never an alert, and never takes the focus. useLocalDraft(key, value, { delay, enabled }) returns { draft, clear }: it saves value to localStorage a moment after the last change (and when the tab is hidden), reports a draft found on mount in draft (null on the server and on the first paint), never overwrites it before the form has changed, and clear() deletes it: call it after the form was saved for real, and from Start over. value must survive JSON.
